primary: Confirm the preselected cheaper escort-difference model versus frozen harmonic on new compositions. Test graph support plus energy/force using both eSEN and independent GFN2 at frozen generated coordinates; no molecular optimization.
primary_gate: Escort-difference common-graph energy per atom lower than harmonic in both model seeds and pooled conditional95 upper bound below zero in BOTH energy evaluators; observed pooled graph and distinct-connectivity loss no more than2pp. GFN2 must succeed on at least90% of graph-supported outputs of both methods, with at least19/24 comparable composition cells per seed. Report graph statistical noninferiority separately, not implied by the observed-rate rule.
secondary: Harmonic versus Gaussian tests the source contribution. Work-difference versus escort-difference tests whether full local work adds benefit; no per-seed method selection. Report all conditions and all unconditioned/selected-support estimands.
failure_policy: Every generated structure remains in validity denominators. Preserve all SCC failures and timeouts. GFN2 success-only and common-graph comparisons retain denominators and do not certify quantum accuracy. No configuration changes or extra draw budget based on these outcomes.
scope: 24 previously unevaluated compositions, selected by metadata and reference assay outside every old official candidate composition and both processed corpora. Existing two model seeds reused; no fresh training replication, population-wide or global Boltzmann guarantee.
